headline.text: L2 cleared a *3-hour* temper fault via reheat — L1 carries three equipment issues into the weekend.

per_plant_summary.L1: Completed nut contamination inspection across two pallets (0.5% defect rate on lot J). Three equipment items need attention: Sollich 3 sprinkler belt has a burnt plug with no replacement on hand, kitchen motor faulting on E-stop, and Sollich 4 tunnel cover repair curing through Sunday morning.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 ran dark chocolate sea salt with temper faults mid-shift due to scraper motor driver. Reheat at 15:27 cleared the issue, system stabilized by 18:15 and ran clean through close. New program saved.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 completed a full Marcos tank flush and changeover to zero-sugar chocolate, ready for Monday startup. ML4 finished level 3 clean and loaded molds after warehouse staged additional totes overnight.

notes.text: Caramel waste barrels flagged for odor and need removal before next production day.
Preston Tregaskis approved plan to push initial zero-sugar chocolate to drums Monday before filling system, given trace residue risk.

resolved.title: Nut lot contamination inspection completed
resolved.summary: First and second pallets of lot J inspected for foreign material (eggs, fuzzy debris) after quality hold, 0.5% defect rate documented.
resolved.resolution: Inspection completed by 22:37 — two pallets processed, defect pieces removed, new LPNs created for IMS.

resolved.title: ML2 temper unit scraper motor fault
resolved.summary: Scraper motor driver faulted multiple times starting at 14:30, dropping bar pressure to 0.1 and halting tempering.
resolved.resolution: Cleared via full reheat at 15:27 and riser pump adjustment to 1100 kg/h. System stabilized by 18:15 — "seeing better results now" (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML4 mold shortage during changeover
resolved.summary: Warehouse staged insufficient mold totes for overnight changeover, crew could not reach remaining stock without forklift.
resolved.resolution: WH operator Alan Ramirez delivered additional totes by 23:51. Mold loading started 04:38.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 kitchen motor E-stop fault
needs_attention.summary: Kitchen motor will not turn on, E-stop signal showing on panel with no clear source.
needs_attention.status: Panel reset temporarily at 13:36, same fault occurring on S2 main line. Jason investigating as of 13:32.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 sprinkler belt burnt plug
needs_attention.summary: Sprinkler belt motor faulting out, plug burnt and no replacement available in stock.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 21:28, part needed for repair. Belt down until replacement sourced.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 shrouds stock-out
needs_attention.summary: Line ran out of shrouds mid-shift, 1.25 pallets of product affected.
needs_attention.status: Stock depleted at 14:54, affected product awaiting packaging material.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 tunnel 1 cover corner detached
needs_attention.summary: Corner piece on tunnel cover (previously glued) fell off during cleaning, taped temporarily then brought to maintenance.
needs_attention.status: Adhesive applied to both sides at 20:42, requires 12-hour cure time before sanding and painting.

needs_attention.title: ML1 pump block water connection leak
needs_attention.summary: One of the water connections on the pump block is actively leaking.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 12:24, no follow-up on repair status in window.

needs_attention.title: Leaking sunflower oil totes
needs_attention.summary: Multiple totes of sunflower oil arriving with leaks on the bottom.
needs_attention.status: Reported as recurring issue at 20:32, no supplier follow-up or containment plan in messages.
